lead.headline: Week won; Warren and Metcalf share a Week 9 bye — claim Coker
lead.deck: 2-5, heading to 3-5: 158.06 to 76.24. Murray's hamstring is the other Week 9 question. Claims clear Wednesday 02:00.
lead.body: The bad news is next week's. Jaylen Warren and DK Metcalf both play for Pittsburgh, who are on bye in Week 9, and Kyler Murray — Jefferson's and Hockenson's quarterback — left Detroit with hamstring tightness and no diagnosis (Heavy 1 Nov); Carson Wentz is the backup. This week is done: Tuten 29.9, Allen 26.6 and Warren 21.3 carried AVIATO to 158.06 against Guillo-tinas' 76.24. Three calls closed RIGHT — Gordon over Metcalf, Hockenson at tight end, the Commanders D/ST. The one move left is the Coker claim, and the Pittsburgh bye makes it cover AVIATO will likely need.
